sqlMap.select: SELECT DISTINCT KEY_1 AS TAX_BILL_NO, KEY_2 AS TO_MAIL, KEY_3 AS TO_NAME, B.ISSUE_ID, B.ISSUE_ID||'.xlsx' AS SRC_FILE_NAME, '[코리아이플랫폼]'||SUBSTR(C.Ar_Close_Month,1,4)||'년 '||SUBSTR(C.Ar_Close_Month,5)||'월 계산서 상세내용 입니다.' AS SUBJECT, '* 입고기간 : '||(SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(GR_DATE),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD') FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE BUYER = A.TARGET AND AR_TAX_BILL_NO = A.KEY_1 AND STATUS != 'D')||' ~ '|| (SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MAX(GR_DATE),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD') FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE BUYER = A.TARGET AND AR_TAX_BILL_NO = A.KEY_1 AND STATUS != 'D') AS GR_TERM, '* KEP 담당자 : ' || D.USER_NAME_LOC ||'/'||D.Phone_Number AS KEP_USER_INFO FROM ICOMTRXL A , XXSB_DTI_MAIN B , KEPTARDT C , ICOMLUSR D WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'AREX' AND A.TARGET = 'KRSAMS0123' AND A.KEY_9 = ' ' AND A.KEY_1 = B.Seq_Id AND A.KEY_1 = C.TAX_BILL_NO AND C.ADD_USER_ID = D.USER_ID

SELECT B.PLANT, B.LEGACY_PO_NO, B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, C.PO_CREATE_DATE, B.BUYER_ITEM_NO, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPECIFICATION, B.UNIT_MEASURE, (SELECT MAX(REQUESTER_NAME) FROM EAI.IF_SEC_PURCHASE_ORDER WHERE PO_NO = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ) AS REQUESTER, (SELECT MAX(PO_CREATOR_NAME) FROM EAI.IF_SEC_PURCHASE_ORDER WHERE PO_NO = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ) AS PURCHASER, B.BUDGET_DEPT, D.TEXT1 AS BUDGET_NAME, A.LEGACY_GR_NO, A.GR_DATE, A.ITEM_QTY, A.ITEM_AMT FROM ICOMGRDT A , ICOMPODT B , ICOMPOHD C , ICOMCOD2 D WHERE A.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0123' AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.AR_TAX_BILL_NO = #TAX_BILL_NO# AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND C.STATUS != 'D' AND D.TYPE = 'C001' AND D.CODE = B.BUDGET_DEPT AND D.COMPANY_CODE = B.BUYER ORDER BY 1
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_8 = #RTN_MSG# , KEY_9 = #RTN_FLG# , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'AREX' AND TARGET = 'KRSAMS0123' AND KEY_1 = #TAX_BILL_NO#

SELECT BC.COM_NAME_LOC BUYER_NAME, SC.COM_NAME_LOC SELLER_NAME, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.LEGACY_PO_NO ||'_'|| A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ REF_IF_NO, B.ADD_DATE, B.ADD_DATE AS GR_DATE, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.MAKER_NAME, A.UNIT_MEASURE, TO_NUMBER(B.MENGE_R) AS PO_QTY, TO_NUMBER(B.MENGE_R) AS GR_QTY, DP.TEXT1 AS PURCHASER_DEPT, C.PURCHASER_NAME, RDP.TEXT1 AS REQ_USER_DEPT, RQ.USER_NAME_LOC AS REQ_USER_NAME FROM ICOMPODT A, COWAY_PO_RETURN B, ICOMPOHD C, ICOMCMPY BC, ICOMCMPY SC, ICOMPRDT D, ICOMCOD2 DP, ICOMLUSR RQ, ICOMCOD2 RDP WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.REMARK = '보상반납_폐기' AND B.ADD_DATE > #FROM_DT# AND B.ADD_DATE <= #TO_DT# AND A.BUYER IN ('KRCOWA0002', 'KRCOWA0003', 'KRCOWA0007', 'KRCOWA0008') AND B.EBELN = A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND B.EBELP = A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO
AND BC.COM_CODE = C.BUYER AND SC.COM_CODE = C.AGENT
AND D.BUYER = A.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND D.PR_SEQ = A.PR_SEQ
AND DP.TYPE = 'C001' AND DP.COMPANY_CODE = D.BUYER AND DP.CODE = D.PURCHASER_DEPT
AND RDP.TYPE = 'C001' AND RDP.COMPANY_CODE = RQ.COM_CODE AND RDP.CODE = RQ.DEPARTMENT
AND RQ.USER_ID = D.REQ_USER_ID
SELECT TEXT1 AS TO_NAME, TEXT2 AS TO_MAIL FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'I006' AND FLAG = 'Y'
